svg.title: NAND is enough: NOT, AND, OR and XOR built from NAND gates
svg.desc: Four panels show NOT, AND, OR and XOR as networks of NAND gates. The inputs A and B step through 00, 01, 10, 11 and the wire colours show each signal rippling through the gates.
